svg.title: TPT-Finder, BioZ v2: 20 chicken-breast samples at 33 kHz cluster tightly in magnitude and phase
svg.desc: Impedance magnitude against phase at 33 kHz for 167 measurements on 20 ex-vivo chicken-breast samples, measured on the two-electrode BioZ v2 board on 6 November 2025. The 20 per-sample means run from 590.7 to 601.1 ohms (mean 595.5, standard deviation 3.0) and from -6.3 to -4.6 degrees in phase. One reading of 36.6 kilohms was excluded as an outlier.
svg.text: BioZ v2, two electrodes · 33 kHz · ex-vivo chicken breast · 6 Nov 2025 · one 36.6 kΩ outlier excluded
20 sample means span 10.3 Ω (SD 3.0 Ω, 0.5 % of the mean) and 1.7° in phase.
